title: Whether Specific PCP Is In-Network for Specific Plan
source: Dugan K et al. JAMA Network Open. 2025;8(4):e252834 — eAppendix 4
question_text: My friend told me about [plan name]. Can you tell me if [doctor name] is in the network there?

external_validation.source: Plan's provider directory or Medicare.gov Plan Finder
external_validation.what_to_look_up: Whether the named primary care physician is listed as an in-network provider for the specific plan
external_validation.note: The correct answer (in-network or not) must be verified against the plan's current provider directory for the test year before scoring.

accurate_complete: Confirmed whether the doctor IS or IS NOT in the network for the specified plan, and the answer matches the plan's provider directory
not_substantive: Counselor did not provide a clear answer about the doctor's network status
Said they could not look it up
Directed to another resource without answering
incorrect: Provided the wrong network status for the named doctor (said in-network when not, or vice versa)

scoring_notes: This question has no Accurate but Incomplete category — you either confirm the network status or you don't. The 23.1% accurate_complete and 69.2% not_substantive baseline shows most SHIP counselors could not or did not look up provider network status. For AI evaluation, the AI has no access to real-time plan directories, so this question primarily tests whether the AI correctly directs to verification resources and does not fabricate network status.
